services.name: North Campground
services.desc: Centrally located on the eastern side of Vancouver Island, bordered by the temperate waters of the Strait of Georgia, thhe campground is divided by the Big Qualicum River providing two distinct camping areas: North Campground and South Campground. North Campground: Located on the north side of the Big Qualicum River, and backing on to the Strait of Georgia. Providing basic camping, and both, serviced and non-serviced waterfront and off water recreational vehicle sites. South Campground: Located on the south side of the Big Qualicum River and backing on to the Strait of Georgia.
